title: osf doctor: read-only setup report
summary: Adds a new `osf doctor` subcommand that assembles a read-only report of six checks — the osf version against `.osf/version`, whether settings load, enabled agents and their credentials, agent binaries (deliberately unknown for now), git hooks, and whether the process is inside the factory image. The new `doctor` module builds `Check` values from existing `config`, `agents`, `githooks` and `reviewers` helpers; `main.rs` gains the CLI surface (`--format text|json`, hidden `--json`, `--check <name>`) and maps a failing check to exit code 1, an unknown check name to 2. Nothing is written, installed or fixed.

nodes.label: osf main
nodes.subtitle: fn main / doctor_cmd
nodes.summary: Adds the `Doctor` variant to the command enum, the `DoctorArgs`/`DoctorFormat` types, and `doctor_cmd`, which resolves the repo root, builds the report, filters it, prints text or JSON, and picks the exit code.

nodes.label: doctor::report
nodes.subtitle: fn report(root, config_file) -> Vec<Check>
nodes.summary: Assembles the six checks in report order: osf, settings, agents, agent-binaries, hooks, container.

nodes.label: doctor::keep
nodes.subtitle: fn keep(checks, wanted) -> Result<Vec<Check>, String>
nodes.summary: Filters the report down to one named check; an unknown name is an error naming the valid choices, which the CLI turns into exit code 2.

nodes.label: Check / Status
nodes.subtitle: struct Check, enum Status
nodes.summary: The report's data model: a name, a status (ok/warn/fail/unknown), a detail line and an optional fix command. Serialises to kebab-case for JSON.

nodes.label: osf_check
nodes.subtitle: fn osf_from_pin(pin, running)
nodes.summary: Compares the running binary version with the `.osf/version` pin; a missing pin warns, `workspace` passes, a mismatch fails.

nodes.label: settings_check
nodes.subtitle: fn settings_check(config_file)
nodes.summary: Calls `config::load` and reports where the settings came from, or the load error with a fix hint.

nodes.label: agents_check
nodes.subtitle: fn agents_check(root)
nodes.summary: Reads the agent selection and, for each enabled reviewer, asks `missing_credential` whether a credential variable or login file is present.

nodes.label: missing_credential
nodes.subtitle: fn missing_credential(agent, env_present, home)
nodes.summary: Pure predicate over an injected env lookup and home path: returns the first missing credential description, or None when a variable or login file satisfies it.

nodes.label: hooks_check
nodes.subtitle: fn hooks_from_status(CheckStatus)
nodes.summary: Maps each `githooks::CheckStatus` variant to a report line; every non-installed state fails with the `osf hooks install` fix.

nodes.label: container_check
nodes.subtitle: fn container_check()
nodes.summary: Probes `/opt/factory` and `/.dockerenv` to say whether the process is inside the factory image; never fails, only ok or warn.

nodes.label: binaries_check
nodes.subtitle: fn binaries_check()
nodes.summary: Always reports `unknown`: agent binaries and pinned versions are not checked until the launch templates land.

nodes.label: doctor tests
nodes.subtitle: unit + integration
nodes.summary: Unit tests cover pin comparison, empty credential values, hook status mapping, credential presence and unknown check names; the integration test drives the real binary for exit codes and JSON output.

nodes.label: config::load
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/config.rs
nodes.summary: Loads and validates `osf.toml`; the doctor reuses it purely to observe whether settings parse.

nodes.label: agents::selection
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/agents.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves the enabled agents, builder and reviewers from config; the doctor reads the result to know which credentials to look for.

nodes.label: githooks::check
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/githooks.rs
nodes.summary: Inspects `core.hooksPath` and returns a `CheckStatus`; the doctor maps it to a report line.

nodes.label: reviewers::real_home
nodes.subtitle: pub(crate) fn real_home()
nodes.summary: Only visibility changed: now `pub(crate)` so the doctor can resolve the home directory for login-file checks.

nodes.label: Repository files

nodes.summary: The version pin and settings file the osf and settings checks read.

nodes.label: Credentials

nodes.summary: The credential variables and login files the agents check probes, via an injected lookup so tests never touch the process environment.

nodes.label: git config

nodes.label: Container markers
